content: He wode Museynne Isra7eele asay ha mazmuriya Godaas yexidosona.

content.text: I ba gita xoonuwan bonchetida gisho,
taani ta Godaas galata mazmuriya yexana.
Goday ta minotethaanne ta mazmuriya gasuwa,
I ta Xoossaa; taani iya sabbana.
I ta aawata Xoossaa; taani iya bonchana; galatana.
Gibxe kawa para gaaretanne iya olanchota Abban yeggis.
Gibxe kawa, ubbaafe aadho gidida toora moconata, Zo7o Abban mitisis.
“Abeeti Godaw, ne ushacha kushey wolqan gooba;
Taani ta mashsha shoddada enta dhaysana’ yaagidi ceeqetis.
Shin neeni enta punnin, Abbay enta mittis.
Abeeti Godaw, Xoossata giddon ne mali oonee?
Bonchoy daggantheynne malaalsiyaba oothey ne mali oonee?
Neeni ne ushacha kushiya miccida wode,
“Neeni wozida asaa ne merina siiquwan kaalethadasa.
Neeni ne wolqan enta ne geeshsha biitta gelsadasa.
He wode Edoome biitta halaqati dagammidosona;
Abeeti Godaw, enti ne wolqaa gitatetha be7idi,
Neeni enta ehada, ne zumaa huuphen tokana.
Abeeti Godaw, he bessay neeni new daanaw doorida bessi,
neeni ne kushiyan minthada keexida ne keethe.

content: Isra7eeleti Abbaa giddora mela biittara pinnin, Gibxe kawa parati, iya para gaaretinne iya para toggeysati Abban gelida wode Goday enta bolla Abbaa haatha zaarin haathay enta mittis.
Aarona michiya, nabiya Mayraama karaabo ekasu. Hara maccasati ubbay banta karaabo ekidi baqishenne yexishe iyo kaallidosona.

content.text: Paranne para toggeyisata I Abban yeggida gisho,
Iyaw mazmuriya yexite” yaagada entaw yexasu.

content: Hessafe guye, Musey Zo7o Abbaa matape Isra7eeleta denthidi Shuura mela biitta gakanaw kaalethis. He mela biittan enti heedzu gallas hemetidosona shin haathe demmibookona.
Enti Maara geetetiya bessi gakidi haathe demmidosona, shin haathay camo gidiya gisho uyanaw danda7ibookona. Hessa gisho, he bessay Maara
Asay, “Nuuni ay uyanee?” gidi Muse bolla zuuzumidosona.
Yaanin, Musey Godaako waassis; Goday iya issi mithi bessis. Musey he mitha haathan yeggin haathay mal7is. Yan Goday entaw higge immis; yan Goday enta paacis.

Musey entako, “Hinte hinte Godaa Xoossaas kiitetite; I koyaba oothite. Hinte taw polo kiitetikonne ta giyaba si7iko Gibxeta bolla ta yeddida hargiyan hintena pirdike. Taani hintena pathiya Godaa” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, enti Elima bidosona. Yan tammanne nam7u haatha pultotinne laapun tammu zamba mithati de7oosona. Enti yan haatha doonan uttidosona.
